sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read

One of the privileges of the Christian life is that God hears our prayers. Jesus has given us prayer as a way of talking to Him. He uses our prayers to bring about His will. Let’s read His Word to learn about prayer.
John 16:24
1 John 5:14
Matthew 6:5-15: (The Lord’s Prayer)
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach
Prayer is a conversation between a person and God.
God wants all of us to come to Him in prayer.
We don’t pray so others will see us or hear us.
We should pray like Jesus prayed - not word for word as He prayed.
We can pray at any time - alone or with others.
God knows what we need before we ask Him.
If we do not forgive others, then God will not forgive us.
Jesus always answers our prayers. Sometimes the answer is no, and sometimes the answer is yes. He answers us according to His will. He knows best.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little, how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan
Shall we pray together?
Use Jesus’ example from Matthew 6:9-13 and pray as a group.
If the people in the group are nervous, show them and then have them pray in their own words.
Explain that sometimes we close our eyes. This is just to help us focus.
Continue sharing the gospel with your family and friends!
To whom will you tell Jesus’ story?
Vision Casting
God deserves for His glory to be known among all people and places. Let’s commit to tell of His glory with all people.
John 14:15
Pray
Ask our heavenly Father to help us always to remember to come to Him in prayer. Thank Him for listening to our prayers.
